pose: An elegant, circular black-shale colored buoy encased in a protective structural framework gilded with reflective, golden pyrite accents. A long-snouted Eurhinosaurus marine reptile is playfully rubbing its leathery back against the underwater mooring lines.

environmental_details.ground: Dark indigo-to-black water with shimmering 'god-rays' piercing through from the surface to frame the golden pyrite accents.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Dramatic, high-contrast light catching the metallic edges of the buoy cage against a deep marine background.
